instruction: Remove all the songs that I have liked from my Spotify queue, and then start the player.
notes: Single-app task (spotify). The agent must learn the queue (show_song_queue) and the liked songs (show_liked_songs, paginate if needed), then remove every queued song that is liked via remove_song_from_queue(position). Because removing a song shifts the positions of the songs after it, removals must be done in descending position order using the positions from the original queue listing; this is enforced in PDDL by a removal chain: (next-liked-removal ?p) points at the highest remaining liked position and (next-liked-below ?p ?below) links to the next lower liked position, with the constant pos-none marking that no liked song remains. The extra parameters ?s and ?below of spotify-remove-song-from-queue are not API arguments. play_music is called with only the access token (resume current queue) and is gated on all liked songs being removed to respect the 'and then' ordering; the goal is (next-liked-removal pos-none), (playing), (task-completed). The concrete instance assumes two liked songs in the queue (consistent with the 8-call reference solution) at illustrative positions 4 and 2 among five queued songs; the actual song ids/positions are discovered at runtime. Non-liked songs stay in the queue since the remove action requires (liked ?s). complete_task takes no answer.
